name: ididntknowhowmightythewindsweretonight
source:
ididntknowhowmightythewindsweretonight is a story about a Snow Lepoard and a Buck trying to find their way through their relationship. And sometimes you dont think to check the weather untill the winds are being blown into your face.  ★

[From [url=https://kazcore.itch.io/ididntknowhowmightythewindsweretonightfirstwinds]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《我不知道今晚的风有多强大》讲述了一只雪豹和一只雄鹿试图在他们的关系中找到出路的故事。有时，直到风吹到你的脸上，你才会想到去查看天气。★
